name: job-search-assistant
description: 17 Claude skills for a careful, personal job search: find and score jobs, true tailored CVs and letters, a portfolio site, career switches, outreach with privacy checks and stop rules, follow-ups, interviews and offers. Plus read-only reviewer agents and hooks that stop Claude sending anything.

block_sending.title: Block sending
block_sending.description: Stop Claude sending, replying, forwarding or posting from your mail, chat and social apps in every session while this plugin is on (drafts still work). Turn off only if you need Claude to send for other work.
